t.zh: 整台机器从一台视觉检查台起步。它不会计算，也碰不到一个像素：它只看图，读别的视觉系统交出的输出，判断哪一份回答了请求。同一张图上能提的问题不止一种，每种问题要的输出形式也不一样。
t.en: The whole machine starts as a vision test station. It computes nothing and cannot touch a single pixel: it looks at the image, reads the outputs other vision systems hand in, and judges which of them answers a request. One image can be asked many kinds of question, and each kind needs its own form of output.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图里有哪些物体、它们在哪里，一个答案至少要带上哪些信息？每一轮有两个问题和三份输出，每份输出照原样写出它说了什么。为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的那一份：缺了信息不够，多带了不需要的也不算刚好。
t.en: This level asks: which objects are in the image and where are they — what must an answer contain at the least? Each round has two questions and three outputs, each written out exactly as it was handed in. Give every question the output that is just enough to answer it: an output missing something falls short, and one carrying more than is needed is not just enough either.

after.zh: 每个物体一个类别加一个<wiki-ref to="bounding-box"></wiki-ref>，是<wiki-ref to="detection"></wiki-ref>的输出；只给类别的是<wiki-ref to="classification"></wiki-ref>，不说位置。
after.en: A class and a <wiki-ref to="bounding-box"></wiki-ref> for each object is the output of <wiki-ref to="detection"></wiki-ref>; a class alone is <wiki-ref to="classification"></wiki-ref>, which says nothing of position.

brief.zh: 为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的输出。
brief.en: For each question, choose the output that is just enough to answer it.

hint.zh: 先读每份输出里写了什么：它说了「是什么」，还是也说了「在哪里」？
hint.en: First read what each output actually says: does it say what is there, or also where?

hint.zh: 图里有两个物体时，「在哪里」要对每一个都答得上。
hint.en: With two objects in the picture, 'where' has to be answered for each of them.

prompt.en: Is there a dog in the picture?

prompt.zh: 图里的每只动物是什么、各在哪里？
prompt.en: What is each animal in the picture, and where is it?

prompt.zh: 画面里的每辆车是哪种车、停在哪里？
prompt.en: What kind of vehicle is each one in the picture, and where is it parked?
Is there a bus in the picture?

why.zh: 类别标签只说图里有什么，不说在哪里：问「各在哪里」的题要每个物体各有一个位置，标签里一个位置也没有。
why.en: A class label says what is in the picture, not where: a question about where each object is needs a position for every object, and the label holds none.
